messages:
Maya: Quick review: structured-output UX for playground run history. Two micro-patterns: "mini-preview" (single-line key/value + copy icon) vs "expanded inline" (full schema preview in row). Need decision for default and a11y checklist.
Samir: Uploaded frames: https://figma.com/s/mini-preview-vs-expanded. Main constraints: network payloads can be large, so list should use compact summaries. Also consider keyboard affordances.
Eli: Accessibility baseline: rows need roving tabindex, Enter toggles expand, Escape closes and returns focus. Use aria-expanded on headers and aria-controls linking to detail region. Announce "Preview expanded" in aria-live when open.
Nora: Copy suggestions: label preview CTA "View params" and primary action on an item should be "Invoke" (not Run). For long schemas, show "Show full schema" instead of exposing raw JSON by default.
Chris: Mini-preview is good for scanning. Expanded inline is better for debugging. My vote: default to mini-preview with a visible affordance to expand. Also add a wide-screen toggle for persistent expanded pane.
Maya: Accessibility nits: ensure focus ring is 4px and meets contrast, avoid focus traps in expanded region, and make the copy-to-clipboard accessible with aria-label.
design-bot: design-token update: spacing between list rows -> 8px for compact mode.
Eli: UX detail: when streaming output, mini-preview should show first completed key/value, then update live. Use a subtle shimmer for streaming state and announce via polite aria-live.
Samir: Engineering: we'll add a compactSummary field from backend to avoid downloading full outputs in list. Client cache expanded payloads LRU 20 entries. Feature-flag gating planned.
Nora: Function defs: render param types as pills with optional descriptions on hover. Hide examples behind "Show example" link.
Chris: Quick poll: reply Mini or Expand. I prefer Mini for default.
Eli: Mini
Nora: Expand (useful when debugging)
Samir: Mini
Maya: Consensus -> Mini-preview as default, inline expand for detailed inspection, with a wide-screen optional pane behind a flag. Eli: can you add keyboard flows and aria-live examples to the prototype? I'll update the ticket with copy and a11y checklist before Thurs sync. Thanks!
